answer: Summit Ledger: each agent anchors identity to one physical mesa sensor - a tamper-evident timber-moisture probe it alone tends, reporting readings each epoch. A farm sharing one probe produces identical moisture curves, so the ledger rejects any two curves correlated above 0.9. One fake costs a full probe install plus 90 days of daily tending; 100 fakes need 100 probes in 100 distinct microclimates - no bulk discount. Verification: any peer can demand a live re-read, and a probe answering with a stale or copied curve fails on the spot.
